prerequisites: Knowledge from the Informatics and Electrical Engineering modules

learning_outcomes.text: Assess the properties and possible applications of microcontrollers.
Identify relevant electronic components and know how microcontrollers must be wired.
Use various sensor and actuator types.
Describe various components of a microcontroller system in the form of a wiki.
Program microprocessors in C with a cross-development system.
Realize an A/D conversion chain and PWM controls.
Create a simple control system programmatically.

syllabus_topics: Components and modules for microcontroller wiring
Embedded systems and real-time operating systems
Independent acquisition of complex knowledge areas
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded based on a passed written examination and evaluated tasks. Successful participation in the internship is a prerequisite for taking the examination. The importance of the grade for the final grade is determined by the Bachelor's examination regulations.
